# meraki_organization_policies_global_group_policy_firewall_ruleset_assignments (Data Source)

This data source can read the `Organization Policies Global Group Policy Firewall Ruleset Assignment` configuration in bulk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meraki_organization_policies_global_group_policy_firewall_ruleset_assignments" "example" {
  organization_id = "123456"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes Set) The list of items (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `policy_id` (String) ID of the policy to assign the ruleset to
- `priority` (Number) Priority of the ruleset assignment (lower numbers = higher priority)
- `ruleset_id` (String) ID of the ruleset to assign
